why: Advice 2 frames break-even CPA as 2万円 × gross margin instead of assuming a margin, and gives dated steps with pass/fail and stop criteria. It also flags that a 10万円 test produces few bookings. Advice 1 relies on assumed margin and CPC figures, and its 2-audience × 3–4-creative test is too spread out to read on a 5–10万円 budget.
